Name: Realtime Map
Author: SirPipocado
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Realtime Map turns the world map into a window to the valley. Hover over any area and a small live preview of that place appears right next to your cursor. Click it to open a large live view that you can drag around and zoom. You’ll see villagers walking, crops growing, animals in their barns, weather and time of day, all as they are right now, without leaving where you are.
It’s built for those “where is everyone?” and “did I leave the gate open?” moments, and it’s just fun to watch the valley go about its day.
[line]
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Open the map (M by default) and hover over any area.[/*]
[/list]To update, delete the old
[code]RealtimeMap[/code]folder and install the new one. If you want to keep your settings, keep
[code]config.json[/code].
[line]
[b]Main features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Live preview on hover:[/b] rest your mouse over any area of the world map to see a small live image of it.[/*]
[*][b]Large live view on click:[/b] click an area to open a big view.
[list]
[*]Drag with the mouse, or move with WASD, the arrow keys or the thumbstick.[/*]
[*]Zoom with the mouse wheel or +/-.[/*]
[*]Close with right-click or ESC.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Interiors included:[/b] houses, shops, the saloon, the clinic and more are reachable straight from the map.[/*]
[*][b]Farm buildings:[/b] see inside your coops, barns, sheds, cabins, slime hutches and greenhouse. When NPC Map Locations is installed, the hover areas line up with its building icons.[/*]
[*][b]“Show live areas” toggle:[/b] a button above the map outlines every area you can view live.[/*]
[*][b]Hide places you don’t care about:[/b] while the outlines are on, right-click an area to hide it (it turns red), and right-click again to bring it back.[/*]
[*][b]Fully configurable:[/b] hover delay, preview size and zoom, starting zoom of the large view, and refresh rate. Change them in
[code]config.json[/code]or in-game with Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*][b]Translations:[/b] English and Brazilian Portuguese. The mod follows your game language automatically.[/*]
[/list][b]Known limitations[/b]
[list]
[*]The JojaMart, abandoned JojaMart and theater rules are designed for the Community Center route. On the Joja route, those areas may show the wrong version.[/*]
[*]Places added by other mods appear only if they’re part of the game’s world map data.[/*]
[*]It’s mainly tested in single-player.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[/list]Optional:
[list]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b], to change the settings in-game[/*]
[*][b]NPC Map Locations[/b], which works together with this mod. The building areas match its icons, and the live view draws above its markers.[/*]
[/list][line]
